python -c "import os, json, time
def survey(p):
    r={'exists':os.path.isdir(p),'files':0,'bytes':0,'oldest':None,'newest':None,'top':[]}
    if not r['exists']: return r
    for root,dirs,files in os.walk(p):
        if root==p: r['top']=sorted(dirs)[:30]
        for f in files:
            fp=os.path.join(root,f)
            try: st=os.stat(fp)
            except OSError: continue
            r['files']+=1; r['bytes']+=st.st_size; mt=st.st_mtime
            if r['oldest'] is None or mt<r['oldest']: r['oldest']=mt
            if r['newest'] is None or mt>r['newest']: r['newest']=mt
    f=lambda t: time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d',time.localtime(t)) if t else None
    r['oldest']=f(r['oldest']); r['newest']=f(r['newest'])
    return r
out={

'claude_history_exists':os.path.exists('C:/Users/llm_development/.claude/history.jsonl'),

'codex_history_exists':os.path.exists('C:/Users/llm_development/.codex/history.jsonl'),
'codex_auth_exists':os.path.exists('C:/Users/llm_development/.codex/auth.json'),
}
print(json.dumps(out))
